title: Question 3
passage: A. A boat has been tied to the upper landing. B. The walkway is blocked by a row of cones. C. The sloping walkway has railings on both sides. D. A bench has been set next to the lower end of the walkway.
passageZh:
A. 有艘船已綁在上方的平台旁。
B. 步道被一排交通錐擋住。
C. 這條斜坡步道的兩側都有欄杆。
D. 長椅已放在步道下端旁。
